title: CI Gradle Wrapper Setup
content:
## Overview

CI jobs invoke the Gradle Wrapper (`gradlew`) to build and test the project. For this to work, the `gradlew` script checked into the repository must have the executable bit set.

## Current State

- The Gradle wrapper script (`gradlew`) is marked executable in the repository so CI can run it directly (e.g. `./gradlew ...`) without needing an extra `chmod` step in the CI pipeline.
- This was fixed via commit 8b13e1fe, which made the wrapper executable.

## Rationale

If `gradlew` loses its executable permission (e.g. due to a checkout on a filesystem/tooling that doesn't preserve permissions, or a fresh commit that adds the file without the exec bit), CI jobs invoking it directly will fail with a permission error. Keeping the executable bit set on `gradlew` in version control avoids this class of failure.
